analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md, adding a documentation paragraph at head lines ~1059-1072 with SDK 27.2 Date-check test commands (scripts/test-check-date-comparisons.py, scripts/test-check-provider-weak-imports.py, scripts/check-date-comparisons.py) and a note that Release Integrity runs scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py on built binaries. The supplied base units (lines 1-927) cover surrounding docs only; the changed hunk sits beyond them, so I reviewed the patch excerpt, which is complete. No runtime, key-handling, attestation, cache or network behavior changes. The added text introduces no new trust boundary or authorization path, no secrets, and no instruction to run anything against production. The commands are local, read-only checks on fixtures and built binaries, and they use `nm -m` and `otool -tV` output from a DevNet build. The relevant retained threat T-041 (prefix cache) is not touched. Remaining unverified items: the scripts named in the docs and the build guide section are not supplied, so whether they exist or enforce what is described is outside this evidence. This is a documentation claim, not a control change. The Release Integrity workflow wiring is also unseen, so I make no claim about the gate's effectiveness. No finding qualifies.
